segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, yeah, this is Eric from Northstar Fabrication. I need to add 8 user seats to our account today. We have a training group starting Monday, August 12.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. I have your account pulled up. You're currently on 42 seats at $38 per seat per month, billed monthly. Do you want the 8 seats active immediately?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, active today if possible. The admin is already set up to invite them, we just hit the seat limit.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I'll update that to 50 seats. The billing tool shows a prorated charge of $122.58 for the remainder of the August billing period, and then your September 1 invoice will reflect 50 seats at $1,900 before tax. Does that look okay?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that matches what I expected. Please go ahead.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, that's updated. Your admin console should show 50 available seats now. I also generated confirmation under ticket 483217, and the prorated charge will appear on invoice INV-10488.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I see it now, yeah, available seats says 8 remaining. Perfect.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. Is there anything else you need today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that's it. Thanks for the quick help.
